scenario_description:
Objective: Add an optional hands-on rescue demo to the Ridgeway clinic roof-access standby window without changing required training or spending.
Emerging Need: A free mobile simulator stop becomes useful only if the site has a cleared van pad, a crew gap, and a reachable coordinator before visitor access locks.
Decision Context: The observable stream moves from routine scheduling to a limited demo offer, a usable contact, a temporary off-roof interval, and a gate-list cutoff.
Consequence: If the window passes, the crew keeps its compliant plan and normal workday; the extra practice opportunity simply disappears.

parameter.title: Ridgeway roof-access readiness huddle
parameter.description: Review Monday access notes and current training roster before roof work resumes.

parameter.subject: Free mobile rooftop-rescue simulator stop in Raleigh on Monday
parameter.body: RescueLab has one no-cost 20-minute mobile simulator window near Raleigh on Monday between 11:30 and 12:30. Safety coordinators may request a tentative hold until 15:00 today; host sites need a cleared vehicle pad and a crew off-roof interval. The coordinator card will be available this morning.

parameter.name: Lena Sato - RescueLab Demo
parameter.notes: Handling today's tentative holds for the Monday Raleigh mobile simulator stop.

parameter.content: Ridgeway membrane delivery shifted. The crew will be off the roof Monday 11:45-12:20 and staying in the south service lot while QA checks finish. Required morning huddle remains unchanged.

parameter.title: Ridgeway Monday visitor gate list
parameter.content: Ridgeway access portal reminder: Monday visitor or demo-vehicle additions need name and plate details before the 15:15 gate-list lock.

parameter.subject: Ridgeway Monday gate list locked
parameter.body: The Monday gate list for Ridgeway Clinic roof work locked at 15:15. No additional training, vendor, or demo vehicles will be accepted for Monday access.
